labels.rationale: The proposed text accurately defines the source baseline, fully preserving the relationship between the baseline material and proposal review as stated in the supplied source.
The proposed text omits the critical relationship to proposal review, providing an incomplete definition that fails to cover the key meaning specified in the supplied source.
The proposal includes an ungrounded claim asserting automatic approval of later changes, which is unsupported by the supplied source.
The supplied source does not specify a retention duration; the proposal correctly identifies this absence of evidence by expressing appropriate uncertainty.

comparison.reviewed_rationale: Supported and complete: preserves the review relationship from the source.
Supported but incomplete: omits the defining review relationship.
Unsupported added claim: automatic approval has no source support.
Justified uncertainty: identifies the missing duration instead of inventing one.
